SRC-080:R001.text: CORE-001: existing-but-corrupt durable audit generation state must fail closed, never infer generation 0, and never publish a generation <= prior durable N; Bridge, browser-dispatch and INAUDIT channels share one coherent semantics; missing file may bootstrap at 1; pending INAUDIT notification stays owed on publish failure; consumers adopt an explicit recovery/reset baseline lower than last observed generation.

SRC-080:R002.text: CORE-002: one explicit cross-process ProjectRegistry refresh primitive acquires the canonical registry lock, loads latest config, synchronizes the existing AppConfig/project collection IN PLACE (preserving object identity) and rebuilds ID indexes; invoked at external Bridge generation consumption and explicit Refresh All so a Bridge-created project is resolvable by AuditService and visible in ProjectRoomModel without restart; no disk I/O on paint/data lookup paths.

SRC-080:R003.text: CORE-003: v3 campaign artifacts require non-empty CAMPAIGN_PROFILE, CAMPAIGN_PROFILE_VERSION and CAMPAIGN_MANIFEST_SHA256; profile id and version must match the selected profile; manifest hash must be exact unless an explicit proven compatibility ledger maps it; manifest_hash_is_compatible rejects missing/arbitrary mismatches by default; parser, resolver and Bridge server agree and never launder an absent/untrusted identity into the current canonical identity after acceptance.
